# Main: Nomura correlations
```{r}
seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "Nomura_2025_GBM/", "Nomura_2025_GBM_merged_seurat_obj.RDS"))
seurat.obj$keep <- !is.na(seurat.obj$CellType)
seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = keep == TRUE)


seurat.obj.oligo <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = CellType == "Oligodendrocyte")
seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, oligo.gene.signatures["reactive.oligo.general"])
seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, gene.signatures.gsea["hypoxia.signature"])


oligo.df <- seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data %>% 
  group_by(Patient, Sample, Timepoint) %>%
  summarize(mean.reactive.oligo = mean(reactive.oligo.general),
            mean.hypoxia.signature = mean(hypoxia.signature)) %>%
  ungroup() 


for (timepoint.use in c("Primary", "Recurrent")) {
  
  if (timepoint.use == "Recurrent") {
    seurat.obj@meta.data <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% mutate(CellTypeBroad = CellType) # merge malignant
  } else {
    seurat.obj@meta.data <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% mutate(CellTypeBroad = ifelse(CellType == "Malignant", State, CellType))
    
  }
  
  celltype.comp.df <- seurat.obj@meta.data %>% 
    group_by(Patient, Sample, Timepoint, CellTypeBroad) %>%
    summarize(count = n()) %>%
    mutate(fraction.celltype = count / sum(count)) %>%
    ungroup() 
  
  
  celltype.comp.wide.df <- celltype.comp.df %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(Patient, Sample, Timepoint), names_from = CellTypeBroad, values_from = fraction.celltype, values_fill = 0)
  
  df <- celltype.comp.wide.df %>% inner_join(oligo.df, by = c("Patient", "Sample", "Timepoint"))
  df <- df %>%
    dplyr::rename(`Reactive oligodendrocyte signature` = mean.reactive.oligo,
                  `Hypoxia signature` = mean.hypoxia.signature)
  
  if (timepoint.use == "Primary") {
    df <- df %>% filter(Timepoint == "T1")
  } else {
    df <- df %>% filter(Timepoint != "T1")
  }
  
  
  # correlation plot
  data <- df
  data$Sample <- NULL
  data$Timepoint <- NULL
  data$Patient <- NULL
  data$count <- NULL
  
  res <- Hmisc::rcorr(as.matrix(data), type = correlation.method.use)
  cor.table <- res$r
  p.mat     <- res$P
  p.mat[is.na(p.mat)] <- 1
  
  p.mat.df <- data.frame(p.mat)
  p.mat.df$celltype <- rownames(p.mat.df)
  write.table(p.mat.df, paste0(figures.dir, "corrplot_by_cell_type_composition_", timepoint.use, "_pvals.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = F, col.names = T)
  
  col_range <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(200)
  
  if (timepoint.use == "Primary") {
    x.use <- 25
    y.use <- 12
  } else {
    x.use <- 16
    y.use <- 8
  }
  
  pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "corrplot_by_cell_type_composition_", timepoint.use, ".pdf"), width = 12, height = 12)
  
  # increase right margin
  par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 6))

  corrplot(
    cor.table,
    order = "hclust",
    hclust.method = "average",
    type = "upper",
    method = "color",
    col = col_range,
    tl.col = "black",
    tl.srt = 45,
    p.mat = p.mat,
    sig.level = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.05),
    insig = "label_sig",
    pch.col = "black",
    pch.cex = 1.2
  )
  text(x = x.use, y = y.use, labels = paste0(str_to_title(correlation.method.use), "'s correlation"), 
   srt = 270, xpd = TRUE, cex = 1.2)
  dev.off()
}  



```



# Supp: Nomura GBM pre- and post-treatment correlations by cell type
```{r}
plot.list <- list()
celltypes <- sort(unique(celltype.comp.df$CellTypeBroad))
celltypes.color.scale <- scale_color_manual(breaks = celltypes, values = as.character(polychrome(length(celltypes))))

df <- celltype.comp.df %>% inner_join(oligo.df, by = c("Patient", "Sample", "Timepoint"))
for (s in celltypes) {
  for (t in c("Primary", "Recurrent")) {
    if (t == "Primary") {
      temp <- df %>% filter(CellTypeBroad == s, Timepoint == "T1")
    } else {
      temp <- df %>% filter(CellTypeBroad == s, Timepoint != "T1")
    }
    
    res <- cor.test(temp$fraction.celltype, temp$mean.reactive.oligo)
    p.val <- res$p.value
    if (res$p.value < 0.001) {
      p.val <- formatC(res$p.value, format = "e", digits = 2)
    } else {
      p.val <- round(res$p.value, 3)
    }
    p <- ggplot(temp, aes(fraction.celltype, mean.reactive.oligo, color = CellTypeBroad)) +
      geom_point() +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
      xlab("Fraction cell type in sample") +
      ylab("Reactive oligodendrocyte signature\nin oligodendrocytes") +
      annotate("text", label = paste0("rho = ", round(res$estimate, 2), "\np-value = ", p.val), x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = 0, vjust = 1) + 
      ggtitle(paste0(s, " - ", t)) + 
      celltypes.color.scale +
      theme(legend.position="none")
    plot.list[[paste0(s, " - ", t)]] <- p
  }
}

p <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = plot.list)
pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, "cell_type_composition_by_cell_type_vs_reactive_oligo_signature.pdf"), width = 30, height = 20)
print(p)
dev.off()
```



# Brad signatures in Nomura
```{r}
seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "Nomura_2025_GBM/", "Nomura_2025_GBM_merged_seurat_obj.RDS"))

oligo.genes <- c("OLIG2", "SOX10", "BCAS1", "ENPP6", "ASPA", "OPALIN", "MOG", "MBP")
seurat.obj$keep <- !is.na(seurat.obj$CellType)
seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = keep == TRUE)

data <- FetchData(seurat.obj, vars =  c("FGF1", "FGF2", "FGFR1", "FGFR2", oligo.genes))
seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, data)

seurat.obj.oligo <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = CellType == "Oligodendrocyte")
seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, oligo.gene.signatures)
seurat.obj.oligo <- add.module.score(seurat.obj.oligo, fgf.gene.signatures)

reactive.oligo.threshold <- median(seurat.obj.oligo$reactive.oligo.general)

# reactive oligo signature cutoff
ggplot(seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data, aes(x = reactive.oligo.general)) + 
  geom_histogram() + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = reactive.oligo.threshold), color = "blue")

seurat.obj.oligo$reactive.oligo <- seurat.obj.oligo$reactive.oligo.general > reactive.oligo.threshold

df <- seurat.obj.oligo@meta.data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = names(fgf.gene.signatures), names_to = "Signature", values_to = "Score") 

p <- ggplot(df, aes(reactive.oligo, Score)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  stat_compare_means() +
  facet_wrap(~Signature)

pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, "reactive.oligo_vs_fgf.gene.signatures.pdf"), width = 12, height = 8)
print(p)
dev.off()
```

# Main: Greenwald GBM pre-treatment spatial correlations
```{r}
library(corrplot)

n.hop <- 3
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "Greenwald_2024_GBM_oligodendrocytes.merged.w.neighborhood.metadata_n.hop=", n.hop, ".RDS"))
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$filter <- is.na(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$Mac)
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, subset = filter == FALSE) # I think the neighborhood was low quality or no neighbors
all.cell.types <- c("AC", "Chromatin.Reg", "Inflammatory.Mac", "Mac", "MES", "MES.Ast", "Prolif.Metab", "Reactive.Ast", "Vasc", "MES.Hyp", "Neuron", "NPC", "Oligo", "OPC")


if (n.hop == 1) {
  seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, subset = n.neighbors >= 3)
} else if (n.hop == 2) {
  seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, subset = n.neighbors >= 9)
} else if (n.hop == 3) {
  seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, subset = n.neighbors >= 10)
}

# Define neighborhood
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$total.Mac <- seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$Mac + seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$Inflammatory.Mac
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$total.MES <- seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$MES + seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$MES.Hyp

mac.cutoff <- 0.1
mes.cutoff <- 0.1

seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$neighborhood.annotation <- apply(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood@meta.data, 1, function(row) case_when(
  as.numeric(row["total.MES"]) <= mes.cutoff && as.numeric(row["total.Mac"]) <= mac.cutoff ~ "MES- Mac-",
  as.numeric(row["total.MES"]) <= mes.cutoff && as.numeric(row["total.Mac"]) > mac.cutoff ~ "MES- Mac+",
  as.numeric(row["total.MES"]) > mes.cutoff && as.numeric(row["total.Mac"]) <= mac.cutoff ~ "MES+ Mac-",
  as.numeric(row["total.MES"]) > mes.cutoff && as.numeric(row["total.Mac"]) > mac.cutoff ~ "MES+ Mac+",
  TRUE ~ NA
))

control.neighborhood <- "MES- Mac-"
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$neighborhood.annotation <- factor(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$neighborhood.annotation, levels = c(control.neighborhood, "MES- Mac+", "MES+ Mac-", "MES+ Mac+"))



# Combining all samples
# TODO calculate inflammatory signature and hypoxia signature in neighborhood not just single spot
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample <- seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood
Idents(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample) <- "sample.id"
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample$downsample <- T
set.seed(123)
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample, subset = downsample == T, downsample = 30)


metadata <- seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample@meta.data
vars.of.interest <- c("reactive.oligo.general", "hypoxia.signature", setdiff(all.cell.types, "Low.quality"))
data <- metadata[, vars.of.interest]
data <- data %>% dplyr::rename(`Reactive oligodendrocyte signature` = reactive.oligo.general,
                               Hypoxia = hypoxia.signature)

res <- Hmisc::rcorr(as.matrix(data), type = correlation.method.use)
cor.table <- res$r
p.mat     <- res$P
p.mat[is.na(p.mat)] <- 1

p.mat.df <- data.frame(p.mat)
p.mat.df$celltype <- rownames(p.mat.df)
write.table(p.mat.df, paste0(figures.dir, "all_samples_combined_corrplot_neighborhood_nhop=", n.hop, "_pvals.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = F, col.names = T)

col_range <- colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(200)
pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "all_samples_combined_corrplot_neighborhood_nhop=", n.hop, ".pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)

par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 6))

corrplot(
  cor.table,
  order = "hclust",
  hclust.method = "average",
  type = "upper",
  method = "color",
  col = col_range,
  tl.col = "black",
  tl.srt = 45,
  p.mat = p.mat,
  sig.level = c(0.001, 0.01, 0.05),
  insig = "label_sig",
  pch.col = "black",
  pch.cex = 1.2
)
text(x = 21, y = 8, labels = paste0(str_to_title(correlation.method.use), "'s correlation"), 
 srt = 270, xpd = TRUE, cex = 1.2)
dev.off()




pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "all_samples_combined_corrplot_neighborhood_nhop=", n.hop, "_pvals.pdf"), width = 20, height = 20)

par(mar = c(5, 4, 4, 6))

corrplot(
  cor.table,
  order = "hclust",
  hclust.method = "average",
  type = "upper",
  method = "color",
  col = col_range,
  tl.col = "black",
  tl.srt = 45,
  p.mat = p.mat,
  sig.level = -1,
  insig = "p-value",
  pch.col = "black",
  pch.cex = 0.8
)
text(x = 21, y = 8, labels = paste0(str_to_title(correlation.method.use), "'s correlation"), 
 srt = 270, xpd = TRUE, cex = 1.2)
dev.off()
```



# Supplemental: Visium linear model
```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

n.hop <- 3
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "Greenwald_2024_GBM/", "Greenwald_2024_GBM_oligodendrocytes.merged.w.neighborhood.metadata_n.hop=", n.hop, ".RDS"))
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$filter <- is.na(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$Mac)
table(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$filter)
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, subset = filter == FALSE) # I think the neighborhood was low quality or no neighbors, TODO investigate
dim(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood)

if (n.hop == 1) {
  seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, subset = n.neighbors >= 3)
} else if (n.hop == 2) {
  seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, subset = n.neighbors >= 9)
} else if (n.hop == 3) {
  seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, subset = n.neighbors >= 10)
}

dim(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood)

oligo.df <- seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood@meta.data %>%
  filter(mp == "Oligo") %>%
  filter(!is.na(reactive.oligo.general)) %>%
  group_by(sample.id) %>%
  mutate(
    y = as.numeric(reactive.oligo.general),
    mes = as.numeric(MES),
    mac = as.numeric(Mac),
    vasc = as.numeric(Vasc),
    hyp = as.numeric(hypoxia.signature) # spot-level hypoxia
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


model <- lmer(
  y ~ mes * mac + vasc + hyp + (1 | sample.id),
  data = oligo.df
)

summary(model)


model <- lmer(
  y ~ mes + mac + vasc + hyp + (1 | sample.id),
  data = oligo.df
)

summary(model)
```



# Main: Greenwald GBM pre-treatment neighborhood vs reactive oligodendrocyte signatures
```{r}
stat.test <- seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample@meta.data %>%
  wilcox_test(reactive.oligo.general ~ neighborhood.annotation, ref.group = control.neighborhood, alternative = "less") %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "neighborhood.annotation") 
stat.test$p.label <- sapply(stat.test$p.adj, format.p.value)

p <- ggplot(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample@meta.data, aes(neighborhood.annotation, reactive.oligo.general)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), fill = "#B76EB8", shape = 21) +
  xlab("Neighborhood") +
  ylab("Reactive oligodendrocyte signature") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.label", size = 6)
pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "all_samples_combined_neighborhood_vs_reactive_oligo_signature_nhop=", n.hop, ".pdf"), width = 10, height = 7)
print(p)
dev.off()
  

# by hypoxia level
hypoxia.cutoff <- median(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample$hypoxia.signature)
seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample$hypoxia.level <- sapply(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample$hypoxia.signature, function(x) ifelse(x > hypoxia.cutoff, "High", "Low"))

stat.test <- seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample@meta.data %>%
  group_by(hypoxia.level) %>%
  wilcox_test(reactive.oligo.general ~ neighborhood.annotation, ref.group = control.neighborhood, alternative = "less") %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "neighborhood.annotation") 
stat.test$p.label <- sapply(stat.test$p.adj, format.p.value)

p <- ggplot(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample@meta.data, aes(neighborhood.annotation, reactive.oligo.general)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), fill = "#B76EB8", shape = 21) +
  xlab("Neighborhood") +
  ylab("Reactive oligodendrocyte signature") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.label", size = 6) +
  ylim(c(-0.3, 0.7)) +
  facet_wrap(~hypoxia.level)
pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, "all_samples_combined_neighborhood_vs_reactive_oligo_signature_by_hypoxia_nhop=", n.hop, ".pdf"), width = 14, height = 7)
print(p)
dev.off()


# demyelination signature
stat.test <- seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample@meta.data %>%
  wilcox_test(acute.demyelination ~ neighborhood.annotation, ref.group = control.neighborhood, alternative = "less") %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
  add_xy_position(x = "neighborhood.annotation") 
stat.test$p.label <- sapply(stat.test$p.adj, format.p.value)

p <- ggplot(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.downsample@meta.data, aes(neighborhood.annotation, acute.demyelination)) + 
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), fill = "#B76EB8", shape = 21) +
  xlab("Neighborhood") +
  ylab("Demyelination signature") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stat.test, label = "p.label", size = 6)
pdf(paste0(figures.dir, "all_samples_combined_neighborhood_vs_demyelination_signature_nhop=", n.hop, ".pdf"), width = 10, height = 7)
print(p)
dev.off()
```

# Supplemental: Greenwald pre-treatment neighborhood vs reactive oligo signature by sample
```{r}
plot.list <- c()
for (s.id in sort(unique(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood$sample.id))) {
  
  temp <- seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood@meta.data %>% filter(sample.id == s.id)
  if (nrow(temp) == 0) {
    next
  }
  
  seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.subset <- subset(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood, subset = sample.id == s.id)
  
  if (
    control.neighborhood %ni% seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.subset$neighborhood.annotation ||
    dplyr::n_distinct(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.subset$neighborhood.annotation) < 2 ||
    sum(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.subset$neighborhood.annotation == control.neighborhood) == 0
  ) {
    stat.test <- data.frame()
  } else {
    stat.test <- seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.subset@meta.data %>%
      wilcox_test(reactive.oligo.general ~ neighborhood.annotation, ref.group = levels(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.subset$neighborhood.annotation)[1], alternative = "less") %>%
      adjust_pvalue(method = "fdr") %>%
      add_significance("p.adj") %>%
      add_xy_position(x = "neighborhood.annotation") 
    stat.test$p.label <- sapply(stat.test$p.adj, format.p.value)
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(seurat.obj.merged.neigborhood.subset@meta.data, aes(neighborhood.annotation, reactive.oligo.general)) + 
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), fill = "#B76EB8", shape = 21) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none") +
    xlab("Neighborhood") +
    ylab("Reactive oligo signature\nin oligodendrocytes") + 
    ggtitle(s.id)
  
  if (nrow(stat.test) > 0) {
    p <- p + stat_pvalue_manual(
      stat.test,
      label = "p.label",
      size = 5
    )
  }
  
  plot.list[[s.id]] <- p
}
p <- plot_grid(plotlist = plot.list)
pdf(paste0(supp.figures.dir, "by_sample_neighborhood_vs_reactive_oligo_signature_nhop=", n.hop, ".pdf"), width = 30, height = 30)
print(p)
dev.off()
```

# Main: Ligand receptor interactions
```{r}
library(liana)

seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", "all_postmortem_samples_cellbender.FALSE_denoise.heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature_filter.FALSE_batch.correction.None/", "seurat_objects/all_postmortem_samples_w_celltypes.velmeshev2019.RDS"))
seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = low.quality.by.qc == FALSE)
seurat.obj$celltype <- seurat.obj$predicted.annotation_l2.w.neftel
unique(seurat.obj$celltype)

Idents(seurat.obj) <- "celltype"
table(seurat.obj$celltype)

for (sample.id.use in unique(seurat.obj$sample.id)) {
  print(sample.id.use)
  seurat.obj.subset <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = sample.id == sample.id.use)
  liana_test <- liana_wrap(seurat.obj.subset, idents_col = "celltype")
  liana_test <- liana_test %>%
    liana_aggregate()
  liana_test$sample.id <- sample.id.use
  write.table(liana_test, paste0(root.dir, "Results/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", "all_postmortem_samples_cellbender.FALSE_denoise.heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature_filter.FALSE_batch.correction.None/", "interactions/", sample.id.use, "_liana_test.tsv"), quote=F, sep="\t", row.names=F, col.names=T)
}
```

# LIANA analysis
```{r}
seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", "all_postmortem_samples_cellbender.FALSE_denoise.heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature_filter.FALSE_batch.correction.None/", "seurat_objects/all_postmortem_samples_w_celltypes.velmeshev2019.RDS"))

output.dir <- "all_postmortem_samples_cellbender.FALSE_denoise.heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature_filter.FALSE_batch.correction.None/"

# combine all samples
liana.df <- data.frame()
for (sample.id.use in unique(seurat.obj$sample.id)) {
  liana_test <- read.csv(paste0(root.dir, "Results/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", output.dir, "interactions/", sample.id.use, "_liana_test.tsv"), sep="\t")
  liana_test <- liana_test #%>% filter(aggregate_rank < 0.1)
  liana.df <- rbind(liana.df, liana_test)
}

unique(liana.df$sample.id)
unique(liana.df$source)

summary.df <- liana.df %>% 
  group_by(source, target, ligand.complex, receptor.complex) %>%
  summarize(n.samples = n_distinct(sample.id),
            n.control.samples = sum(sample.id %in% healthy.sections),
            n.tumor.samples = sum(sample.id %ni% healthy.sections),
            sample.ids = paste(sample.id, collapse = ", "),
            median.aggregate_rank = median(aggregate_rank),
            median.sca.LRscore = median(sca.LRscore),
            median.edge_specificity = median(natmi.edge_specificity))
summary.df$n.tumor.control.samples.diff <- summary.df$n.tumor.samples - summary.df$n.control.samples
summary.df$interaction.label <- paste0(summary.df$ligand.complex, "->", summary.df$receptor.complex, "|", summary.df$source, "->", summary.df$target)
write.table(summary.df, paste0(root.dir, "Results/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", output.dir, "interactions/", "all_samples_combined_liana_summary.tsv"), quote=F, sep="\t", row.names=F, col.names=T)


library(writexl)
write_xlsx(summary.df, path = paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Tables/", "Table SX LIANA predictions.xlsx"))




mes.oligo.df  <- summary.df %>% filter(source == "MES-like (Neftel)", target == "Oligodendrocytes") %>% arrange(desc(n.tumor.control.samples.diff))
oligo.mes.df <- summary.df %>% filter(source == "Oligodendrocytes", target == "MES-like (Neftel)") %>% arrange(desc(n.tumor.control.samples.diff))
mes.oligo.interactions.df <- rbind(mes.oligo.df, oligo.mes.df) %>% arrange(desc(n.tumor.control.samples.diff)) %>% filter(n.tumor.samples >= 5)

mes.oligo.interactions.df$interaction.label %>% paste0(collapse = "    ")

intersect(oligo.gene.signatures$reactive.oligo.general, mes.oligo.df$receptor.complex)
intersect(oligo.gene.signatures$reactive.oligo.general, oligo.mes.df$ligand.complex)


mac.oligo.df  <- summary.df %>% filter(source == "Myeloid", target == "Oligodendrocytes") %>% arrange(desc(n.tumor.control.samples.diff))
oligo.mac.df <- summary.df %>% filter(source == "Oligodendrocytes", target == "Myeloid") %>% arrange(desc(n.tumor.control.samples.diff))
mac.oligo.interactions.df <- rbind(mac.oligo.df, oligo.mac.df) %>% arrange(desc(n.tumor.control.samples.diff)) %>% filter(n.tumor.samples >= 5)


mac.oligo.interactions.df$interaction.label %>% paste0(collapse = "    ")

intersect(oligo.gene.signatures$reactive.oligo.general, mac.oligo.df$receptor.complex)
intersect(oligo.gene.signatures$reactive.oligo.general, oligo.mac.df$ligand.complex)



malignant.oligo.df  <- summary.df %>% filter(source %in% c(malignant.states), target == "Oligodendrocytes") %>% arrange(desc(n.tumor.control.samples.diff))

df <- malignant.oligo.df %>% filter(receptor.complex %in% c("FGFR1", "FGFR2"), ligand.complex %in% c("FGF1", "FGF2"))
```
